Context: 3. Certain Special Entries.-

- (iv) Entries in Columns 2 & 3.Entry in Column 3 against entry already made in Column 2 will arise on the grant of annual increment or relief on transfer, etc. If entry in Column 3 is for annual increments, simultaneous entry under Column 2 as next entry to be made. (Example: for increment on 1st January, entry in Column 3 will be 31st December and in Column 2 as next entry will be 1st January with the new pay shown in Column 6 or 5, as the case may be).
